dangerous hail and damaging winds.

structure.

report your observations to the National Weather Service office in
Rapid City via phone, email, or social media, as soon as it is safe
to do so.

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.description:
The storms which prompted the warning have weakened below severe
limits, and no longer pose an immediate threat to life or property.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.
